approval_required_for: Conditional bounded approval is required only if the passed board-discovery materials cannot uniquely identify the exact user-supplied wrapper/export hashes and an authorized Vivado-derived simulator command; the team must not guess target names, source paths, or executables.

consumes: immutable current input stimulus provenance or deterministic stimulus seed/provenance
current resolved numeric comparison policy, including frozen framework defaults only when initially absent
passed case_board_interface_discovery identity document and exact user-supplied wrapper/export source hashes
current DUT loader and integration source set
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the verification-capability gap and all SACG barriers active; do not run VCS, alter tolerance, use random or DUT-derived expected outputs, substitute a wrapper, or patch lower-layer RTL. If the discovery material cannot uniquely bind wrapper/export hashes and an authorized simulator command, emit a bounded approval request rather than guessing.
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the known capability gap before any hardware diagnosis: create a complete target-checkpoint catalog, a Transformer-block DUT-required subset for every selected target layer, an immutable target-model reference, a loader-to-DUT binding contract, and the missing exact-wrapper board testbench/compile-plan closure. This is a bounded board integration harness repair, not a core RTL, architecture, numeric-policy, or model-tail change.

executable_actions.on_failure: Return only to repair.build_hash_bound_multilayer_board_semantic_candidate with the reported missing tensor, loader binding, or source-hash detail. Do not run dependency-skipped VCS/AXI tools, claim DUT consumption, reopen lower layers, or promote.
executable_actions.rationale: Validate the repaired all-target-layer binding and harness source closure before attempting dependent AXI/DDR or simulator gates. This gate validates requirements and source closure only; actual DUT weight consumption remains to be proven by the later real simulation.

consumes: passed case_board_interface_discovery identity document and exact source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Treat this as a current-layer board harness/compile-authority failure. Return to the bounded harness repair; do not replace the user wrapper, guess Vivado contexts or executables, run VCS against an unbound compile plan, or reopen certified lower layers.
executable_actions.rationale: Once multilayer binding passes, validate that the candidate uses the exact discovered wrapper/export identity and a tool-profile-authorized Vivado-derived VCS compile plan before real simulation. This resolves the reported readiness, source_identity, compile_authority, authority_refs, and executable-binding deficiencies without changing the wrapper contract.

consumes: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, testbench, and wrapper source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: If execution produces a trace, invoke repair.localize_current_board_trace before any code patch. If the simulator cannot execute because a contract artifact is absent, return to repair.build_hash_bound_multilayer_board_semantic_candidate. Do not characterize a dependency failure as RTL evidence and do not relax numeric policy.
executable_actions.rationale: After prerequisite gates pass, execute the real board simulation on the immutable checkpoint/stimulus/reference and collect the current board boundary, consumption, order, liveness, and numeric evidence. The trace must distinguish AXI/prefetch progress from output or lifecycle-frontier progress and preserve elastic kernel timing semantics.

consumes: hierarchical_learning_context kernel timing knowledge and certificate hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: If the trace is incomplete or not hash-bound, rerun only the current board trace with the required monitors; do not patch RTL. If no direct lower-layer contradiction is present, retain lower certificates and issue only a bounded board wrapper/loader/harness/runtime repair context. If a direct contradiction is present, record the named invariant and request only the challenged lower-layer replay before rerunning this board layer.
executable_actions.rationale: Use only fresh current-layer trace evidence to identify the earliest violated board contract. A lower-layer challenge is authorized only when the trace is hash-bound to the current candidate and explicitly contradicts a named live lower-layer invariant with direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: For an executed liveness, value, order, protocol, or consumption failure, return to repair.localize_current_board_trace_and_guard_lower_certificates and repair only the earliest localized current-layer slice. For a missing or unbound artifact, return to repair.build_hash_bound_multilayer_board_semantic_candidate. Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, or board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after real simulation and its prerequisite contract evidence are available, run the remaining required board-layer gates in dependency order and assemble semantic evidence showing exact-wrapper execution, complete bound-weight consumption, target-model comparison, AXI/DDR protocol behavior, data order, and liveness. This is the required same-layer rerun; it is not backend promotion.

consumes: all current board real-tool reports and source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Retain all ten active barriers and all four open retry requests as downstream blockers, keep the candidate unpromoted, and return to the failed current-layer action. Do not consume rejected artifacts as validated inputs or claim retry reconciliation without a full passing content-addressed candidate.
executable_actions.rationale: Preserve the authoritative active-barrier and retry history while recording a content-addressed candidate for the owning verification/promotion flow. Same-scope retries and contaminated artifacts remain downstream-consumption blockers unless the full candidate passes every required board gate and is subsequently reconciled; this action does not itself claim promotion or silently clear barriers.

observations: The directly executed current-layer checker real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline failed on multilayer_real_weight_binding and multilayer_harness_sources. A weight file or binding manifest alone will not establish DUT consumption; executed loader-to-DUT evidence is still required.

The current functional_sim failure is a precondition/dependency failure caused in part by missing verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv. VCS, evidence analysis, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, and downstream board classifiers are not_run, so no RTL root cause, AXI failure, deadlock, numeric mismatch, or output-frontier stall is established.

case_board_interface_discovery is reported pass in the current hierarchy, but the repaired board harness must bind the exact discovered user-project wrapper/export source hashes and an authorized Vivado-derived compile plan. A simplified wrapper or guessed tool command is prohibited.

Certified operator-leaf and connected single-layer evidence is live and reusable. The connected kernel certificate requires elastic variable-latency token-pipeline boundary order and cross-token overlap, not same-cycle completion across unequal-latency stages. No current hash-bound board trace contradicts either lower-layer certificate.

The current diagnostic closure classifies this as a verification_semantic_capability_contract gap and explicitly requires semantic harness/loader repair before hardware boundary tracing. The historical VCS analyzer result is not executable for this attempt because it lacks a current source-bound applicability binding.

sacg_memory_truth authoritatively reports 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and four open same-scope retry requests (retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142); no same-scope backtrack request is open. Rejected artifacts remain usable only as debugging inputs, not validated design inputs.
The conditional review router selected no specialist split. The invalid prior repair-execution feedback cannot be used as successful repair evidence.
proposed_actions: Build a bounded, hash-bound board semantic verification candidate that repairs only the multilayer loader/harness, testbench contract, and required instrumentation; preserve the DUT scope, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, and exact board-wrapper sources.
Rerun case_multilayer_pipeline before attempting VCS. If static binding or harness closure still fails, iterate only the verification-capability repair and do not infer hardware behavior.

After the static board gates pass, run the exact-wrapper VCS simulation and collect a current CCTG boundary trace, consumption trace, order/numeric evidence, and diagnosis. Localize any executed failure to the earliest board causal boundary.

Run remaining board gates only after their prerequisites pass. Reopen a lower layer only if a fresh trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant; otherwise repair only the localized board wrapper, loader, harness, runtime, or instrumentation slice.

Keep all active SACG barriers and retries as downstream-consumption blockers until a new content-addressed Stage7 candidate passes every required board gate and is reconciled by the owning SACG/promotion flow.
risks: Model/numeric risk: a multilayer test could falsely pass if expected outputs are not produced by target-model inference on the identical immutable checkpoint and stimulus, if resolved tolerances are changed during repair, or if Transformer-block boundary outputs are confused with embedding, final norm, LM-head/logits, or sampling work outside the DUT.

Shape/data-order/memory/runtime risk: every selected target layer requires a complete tensor catalog, tensor hashes, layer ordering, loader address/order mapping, transfer counts, and observed DUT consumption; an all-layer manifest without executed consumption traces is insufficient.

Board/implementation risk: the testbench, wrapper, source identity, Vivado export contexts, and simulator commands must remain hash-bound to the exact user sample project. Any ambiguity in this mapping must be escalated rather than resolved by guessing.

Current-layer liveness risk remains unmeasured. Independent AXI or prefetch activity would not prove kernel egress or lifecycle-frontier progress; any future frontier symptom must be localized from a current trace before an RTL repair is proposed.

The active contamination barriers and open retry requests block downstream consumption and promotion until a content-addressed candidate completes the full current-layer gate chain and SACG reconciliation is performed.

constraints: no lower-layer reopen without a current trace that contradicts a named certified invariant
active SACG artifacts are planning/debug evidence only until a new candidate passes and is reconciled

The earliest executed failure is a verification-capability failure in case_multilayer_pipeline: complete Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding and hash-verified multilayer harness sources are absent; board_tb.sv is also absent. functional_sim is dependency-unsatisfied aggregate status, not executed RTL, AXI, DDR, numeric, or liveness evidence. Repair the current board-scope loader/harness and immutable semantic contract first, then rerun the board gate chain and obtain a current boundary trace if simulation executes. Do not reopen certified leaf or connected-kernel layers and do not promote to backend or board runtime.
